cases.name: skip-value
cases.cs: int n=0; for(int i=1;i<=5;i++){if(i==3)continue; n++;} return n;

cases.name: increment-still-runs
cases.cs: int sum=0; for(int i=1;i<=5;i++){if(i%2==0)continue; sum+=i;} return sum;

cases.name: while-continue
cases.cs: int i=0,n=0; while(i<4){i++; if(i==2)continue; n++;} return n;
